title: 30 TIPS and TRICKS to Become A PRO Astraeos Ark Ascended Player
description:
Here are 30 tips and tricks to help you dominate the new ark map Astraeos in Ark Survival Ascended. In this video, I'm diving deep into 30 essential tips and tricks that will help you master Ark Astraeos whether you’re playing PvE or PvP. If you want to thrive in this new world, you need the right knowledge, and that’s exactly what this Ark Astraeos guide will provide.
Surviving on Ark Astraeos is about knowing where to farm every resource, getting the best tips and tricks, taming the new Maeguana, using advanced Ark survival strategies, and using the environment of the new Therokis Island to your advantage. Whether you're looking for Ark Astraeos beginner tips to get started, or advanced tips to take your gameplay to the next level, this video has it all. 
If you're struggling to get started, these Astraeos tips and tricks will help you build a solid foundation so you don’t waste time making common mistakes. I’ll also cover Ark tips and tricks for late game Astraeos content, including full cave walkthroughs, OSD and Element Vein strategies, and boss guides that can help you get loot that dominates in PvP.
If you found these Astraeos tricks helpful, don’t forget to subscribe for more in-depth Ark Survival Ascended content, including Ark Astraeos guides, PvE strategies, PvP tips, and everything you need to master Ark Survival Ascended. Hit the LIKE button if this guide helped you, and let me know in the comments what you’d like to see next!
